rationale: A recognized match with a wildcard arm: the wildcard value holds for every variant the match does not name (steps 2-3 — match semantics: `.Light` is not named, so `_` applies); `.Dark` re-binds it.
choice: Step 1 asserts a CHOICE, not a ruling (review F2): the wildcard arm is emitted as a bare `:root` default, so it also holds BEFORE any variant is reflected on `:root`. §66.17 item 3 names only the `:root[data-scrml-theme-<cell>="<V>"]` blocks; lowering `_` as `:root` is an inference (it is exact for every reflected variant the match does not name, and additionally defines the pre-reflection value).
